headline: Anuh Pharma signs Asset Transfer Agreement
hook: Asset transfer deal at Anuh Pharma
summary: Anuh Pharma Limited has officially informed the stock exchange about the execution of an Asset Transfer Agreement. The filing provides no specific financial details, asset values, or the identity of the counterparty involved in the transaction. Investors will need to await further disclosures for clarity on how this transfer impacts the company's balance sheet or operations.
whats_next: Detailed exchange disclosures regarding the asset transfer terms
why_it_matters: Financial impact remains unclear pending further disclosures.

headline: Anuh Pharma board approves investment and loan acquisition
hook: Board approves new investment and credit facilities
summary: Anuh Pharma Limited announced the outcome of its board meeting held on October 13, 2026. The company's board approved decisions regarding new investments and availing of loan facilities. These strategic financial moves will fund upcoming corporate activities and operational requirements. Retail investors should track how these credit facilities impact the company's debt-to-equity ratio and future capital deployment.
why_it_matters: Company debt and investment strategy shift slightly.
